subject: general
question: Sunil Chhetri made history by becoming the first Indian to score a hat-trick in the Hero ISL, which came in the ______ edition.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sunil Chhetri scored his first hat-trick in the Hero Indian Super League (ISL) during the **2015 edition**.
 
• He achieved this milestone while playing for Mumbai City FC.
 
• The match took place on November 8, 2015, against NorthEast United FC.
 
• Sunil Chhetri is regarded as one of the most prolific footballers in Indian football history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hero Indian Super League (ISL)**

 
 
• The ISL is one of the top professional football leagues in India, founded in 2013.
 
• The league operates with a system of franchise teams, with no promotion or relegation.
 
• It has significantly contributed to the growth and popularity of football in India.
 
• ISL follows a format similar to other global leagues, featuring a regular season and playoffs culminating in a final match.
 
 
 
• **Sunil Chhetri**
 
 
• He is the captain of the Indian national football team and Bengaluru FC.
 
• Chhetri is among the highest goal scorers in international football, making significant contributions to Indian football.
 
• He has received multiple accolades, including the AIFF Player of the Year award multiple times.
 
• Chhetri's leadership and skill have been pivotal in elevating the status of Indian football on the global stage.
 
 
 
• **Hat-trick**
 
 
• A hat-trick in football refers to a player scoring three goals in a single match.
 
• It is considered a significant achievement and is celebrated by fans and players alike.
 
• Scoring a hat-trick often highlights a player's exceptional performance in a game.
 
• In many leagues, the player who scores a hat-trick often gets to keep the match ball as a memento.
 
 
 
• **Mumbai City FC**
 
 
• Mumbai City FC is a professional football club based in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• The club was founded in 2014 and has been a part of the ISL since its inception.
 
• Mumbai City FC has seen various international and national players contribute to its success over the years.
 
• The team won the ISL Championship and League Winners Shield in the 2020-2021 season.
